name: Knockhill Racing Circuit
description: Scotland's national circuit in Fife. Short, hilly and tight, with blind crests and a slow hairpin. The lap is over in under a minute.
direction_note: Points are ordered in race direction. Index 0 is the start/finish line.
raceline_source: modules/tracks/tools/raceline.py (minimum lap time, GT3 point-mass model)

elevation.source: Terrarium elevation tiles, AWS Open Data (SRTM, USGS 3DEP, national lidar), smoothed

barriers.source: OpenStreetMap barriers (383 of 814 edge points mapped) and gravel areas, defaults by corner and circuit style elsewhere
